zh.title: 全日空公開綠色寶可夢彩繪機 波音787首航檀香山
zh.summary: 全日空發表綠色寶可夢波音787彩繪機，正式執飛東京羽田至檀香山國際航線。
body: 全日空（All Nippon Airways）於2026年9月18日正式公開亮相旗下最新特殊塗裝彩繪機「綠色寶可夢彩繪機」（Green Pokémon Jet），該架客機機型為波音787-9（Boeing 787-9，國籍標誌暨登記號碼JA923A）。在東京羽田國際機場（HND）舉辦歡迎儀式後，該機於當晚執行NH186首航商業航班，啟程飛往美國夏威夷檀香山（HNL），標誌著該彩繪機國際航線營運計畫正迅速展開。
根據航班紀錄與航空公司說明，首航班機NH186於東京時間9月18日晚間9時55分自羽田機場起飛，並於檀香山當地時間下午2時前順利降落。這架波音787-9客機為全日空三款寶可夢主題彩繪機系列中的第二架，主體設計以草屬性寶可夢為核心視覺，機身塗裝呈現顯著的綠色基調。全日空亦將寶可夢主題延伸至客機艙內，提供限定版頭靠墊、主題設計飲料紙杯與餐巾紙，並播放專屬背景音樂及提供紀念貼紙。

全日空表示，「綠色寶可夢彩繪機」已被主要派飛於國際航線，營運計畫預計至少持續至2027年3月。該機從東京羽田機場（HND）出發的航點包含檀香山（HNL）、西雅圖（SEA）、溫哥華（YVR）、雪梨（SYD）、馬尼拉（MNL）、新加坡（SIN）、德里（DEL）、曼谷（BKK）、雅加達（CGK）及吉隆坡（KUL）；從東京成田國際機場（NRT）出發的航點則包含伯斯（PER）、新加坡（SIN）、曼谷（BKK）、雅加達（CGK）與孟買（BOM）。

此項特殊塗裝企劃旨在紀念全日空與寶可夢公司合作30週年，同時也是全日空自1998年以來第13架採用寶可夢彩繪的客機。該系列共規劃三架主題彩繪機，除了已投入營運的「綠色寶可夢彩繪機」外，第一架「紅色寶可夢彩繪機」為波音787-8客機（國籍標誌暨登記號碼JA819A），已於2026年7月29日起執飛日本國內航線；第三架「藍色寶可夢彩繪機」則為波音737-800客機（國籍標誌暨登記號碼JA56AN），預計於2026年底亮相並同樣投入國內線營運。
除了空中航班營運外，全日空亦結合地面行銷活動，在日本國內14座機場設置《Pokémon GO》遊戲內的補給站與道館，涵蓋高知（KCZ）、松山（MYJ）、高松（TAK）、德島（TKS）、福岡（FUK）、佐賀（HSG）、宮崎（KMI）、熊本（KMJ）、鹿兒島（KOJ）、長崎（NGS）、大分（OIT）、石垣（ISG）、宮古（MMY）及那霸（OKA）等機場，供玩家參與專屬互動任務。

en.title: ANA Unveils Green Pokémon Jet Boeing 787-9 for International Routes
en.summary: All Nippon Airways launched its Green Pokémon Boeing 787-9 jet on its inaugural flight from Tokyo to Honolulu.
body: All Nippon Airways (ANA) officially unveiled its newest special livery aircraft, the "Green Pokémon Jet," on September 18, 2026. The aircraft, a Boeing 787-9 registered as JA923A, made its public debut following a welcoming ceremony at Tokyo's Haneda International Airport (HND). Later that evening, the widebody jet departed on its inaugural commercial passenger service, flight NH186, bound for Honolulu (HNL), Hawaii, marking the launch of its international flight program.

According to flight details, NH186 departed Tokyo Haneda at 9:55 p.m. local time on September 18 and arrived in Honolulu just before 2:00 p.m. local time. The Boeing 787-9 is the second aircraft in a three-livery Pokémon series and features a predominant green design centered on Grass-type Pokémon characters. ANA has extended the special theme into the cabin, equipping seats in Premium Economy and Economy with branded headrest covers, serving beverages in themed cups with custom napkins, playing themed background music, and distributing commemorative stickers to passengers.

ANA confirmed that the Green Pokémon Jet will be assigned across its international long-haul network until at least March 2027. Scheduled operations from Tokyo Haneda (HND) include routes to Honolulu (HNL), Seattle (SEA), Vancouver (YVR), Sydney (SYD), Manila (MNL), Singapore (SIN), Delhi (DEL), Bangkok (BKK), Jakarta (CGK), and Kuala Lumpur (KUL). From Tokyo Narita (NRT), the aircraft is planned to serve Perth (PER), Singapore (SIN), Bangkok (BKK), Jakarta (CGK), and Mumbai (BOM).

The special livery project marks the 30th anniversary of the partnership between All Nippon Airways and The Pokémon Company, representing the 13th ANA aircraft to receive a Pokémon livery since 1998. The current generation consists of three distinct jets: the Boeing 787-8 "Red Pokémon Jet" (JA819A), which entered service on Japanese domestic routes on July 29, 2026; the international Boeing 787-9 "Green Pokémon Jet"; and the upcoming Boeing 737-800 "Blue Pokémon Jet" (JA56AN), which is scheduled for unveiling toward the end of 2026 for domestic flights.

In addition to inflight experiences, ANA is conducting ground-based promotional activities by introducing in-game PokéStops and Gyms for Pokémon GO players at 14 airports across Japan. Participating locations include Kochi (KCZ), Matsuyama (MYJ), Takamatsu (TAK), Tokushima (TKS), Fukuoka (FUK), Saga (HSG), Miyazaki (KMI), Kumamoto (KMJ), Kagoshima (KOJ), Nagasaki (NGS), Oita (OIT), Ishigaki (ISG), Miyako (MMY), and Naha (OKA), allowing passengers and visitors to take part in localized challenges.

zh.title: 紐西蘭航空最後一架停飛波音787離澳洲沙漠復飛
zh.summary: 紐航最後一架停飛787離開澳洲沙漠；特倫特1000發動機風波結束
body: 根據Simple Flying於2026年9月18日報導，紐西蘭航空最後一架因特倫特1000發動機問題而停飛的波音787已離開澳洲沙漠存放地，結束長達9個月的地面停放狀態。
該報導指出，這標誌著紐西蘭航空已將特倫特1000發動機擾亂事件畫下句點，機隊全數恢復運營。
背景方面，波音787項目近期也有其他發展：美國聯邦航空局（FAA）已針對部分787機型發布機翼檢查指令；聯合航空與勞斯萊斯就發動機耐久性出現爭議；澳洲航空決定提前退役A380並轉向787等機型。

en.title: Air New Zealand's Last Grounded Boeing 787 Leaves Australian Desert After 9 Months
en.summary: Air New Zealand's last grounded 787 leaves Australian desert; Trent 1000 disruption ends
body: According to a report published by Simple Flying on September 18, 2026, Air New Zealand's last Boeing 787 that had been grounded due to Trent 1000 engine issues has left the Australian desert storage facility where it had been parked for nine months.
The article states that this departure marks the end of the Trent 1000 disruption for the airline, with its fleet now fully returned to service.

In related background, the Boeing 787 programme has seen other recent developments: the FAA issued an airworthiness directive for wing inspections on certain 787s; United Airlines is in a dispute with Rolls-Royce over engine durability; and Qantas has decided to retire its A380s early while converting orders toward 787s and A350s.

zh.title: 達美航空規劃2027年初在明尼阿波利斯-聖保羅建立A350基地
zh.summary: 達美航空擬2027年初於MSP設A350基地；深化佈局可開季節性長程航線
body: 根據Simple Flying於2026年9月18日報導，達美航空規劃於2027年初在明尼阿波利斯-聖保羅（MSP）建立空中巴士A350基地。
報導指出，深化MSP佈局可能解鎖季節性長程航線，並使關鍵跨大西洋航線機材現代化。
空中巴士A350亦為其他航空公司所採用，如加拿大航空已選擇最多16架A350-1000。
另據Simple Flying早前報導，聯合航空面臨勞斯萊斯引擎耐久性爭議，導致其45架A350存於風險。

en.title: Delta Air Lines Plans Minneapolis–St. Paul A350 Base for Early 2027
en.summary: Delta Air Lines plans MSP A350 base early 2027; deeper footprint may unlock seasonal long-haul routes
body: Delta Air Lines plans to open an Airbus A350 base at Minneapolis–St. Paul (MSP) in early 2027, as reported by Simple Flying on 18 September 2026.
The article notes that a deeper MSP footprint could unlock seasonal long-haul links and modernize aircraft on key transatlantic routes.
Air Canada recently selected up to 16 Airbus A350-1000 aircraft, highlighting continued demand for the type.
In related A350 developments, United Airlines is dealing with a Rolls-Royce engine durability dispute that puts 45 of its A350s at risk, per another Simple Flying article.
